Running the cath lab of CARE's flagship Banjara Hills cardiac campus means directing the single highest-revenue clinical unit in the hospital - a P&L-adjacent leadership post, not merely a senior clinical title. FOUR INTERNATIONAL/NATIONAL FELLOWSHIPS: his published qualifications are MBBS, MD, DM (PGIMER), FACC, FSCAI, FESC, FICC - Fellow of the American College of Cardiology, Fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions (USA), Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology, and Fellow of the Indian College of Cardiology. PREMIUM SUBSPECIALTY LINES: trans-radial access, complex coronary intervention and IVUS-guided intervention - the imaging-guided complex-PCI end of the field; plus peripheral intervention, cardiac ablation (electrophysiology) and pacemaker implantation, an unusually broad high-value procedural range for one operator. MULTI-SITE: consults at both CARE Hospitals Banjara Hills and the separate CARE Hospitals Outpatient Centre, Banjara Hills. THOUGHT LEADERSHIP: signed author in CARE's 'Doctor Speak' clinical column ('Lifestyle & Heart Health'). INTERNATIONAL PATIENT PROFILE: carried on medical-tourism directories (Vaidam, MediJourney, American Health Tourism), which typically feature the consultants a hospital markets to overseas self-pay patients.
